# Programme Terms Card: Stones, Designers, Consultation Deposits and Concurrent Commissions

The card below sets, for each programme of Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, whether a stone the customer brings in may be used in the piece, whether stones taken out of an heirloom piece may be remounted, whether the customer must sign the release before the chain works with a stone they supplied, the standing a designer must hold to carry the commission, the hours of designer time included in the quoted total, the amount taken at the consultation before design work begins, and how many commissions one customer may have running under the programme at once.

## Terms by programme

| Programme | Supplied stone accepted | Heirloom remount accepted | Stone release required | Designer standing required | Designer hours included | Consultation deposit | Commissions running at once per customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | no | no | no | studio designer | 1 | USD 0.00 | 3 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | yes | no | yes | studio designer | 2 | USD 100.00 | 3 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | yes | yes | yes | senior designer | 4 | USD 250.00 | 2 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | yes | yes | yes | signature designer | 8 | USD 500.00 | 2 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | yes | yes | yes | restoration designer | 5 | USD 350.00 | 2 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | yes | yes | yes | atelier director | 20 | USD 2500.00 | 1 |

## Points of judgement

- **Supplied stone.** A supplied stone is accepted under every programme except the Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting.
- **Heirloom remount.** Remounting stones from an heirloom piece is accepted under Belrose Bespoke Design, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission, the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission, and not under either Design Studio programme.
- **Stone release.** Every programme that accepts a supplied stone requires the release; the Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting, which accepts none, requires none.
- **Consultation deposit.** The Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting takes no consultation deposit (USD 0.00); every other programme takes the amount listed before design work begins.
- **Concurrent commissions.** The figure in the last column is the number of that programme's own commissions that may run for one customer at the same time: 3 under either Design Studio programme, 2 under Belrose Bespoke Design, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission and the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission, and 1 under the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission.
